# scrcpy-installer — generator page

> Configure scrcpy via a web form and get a copyable oneliner that installs
> scrcpy from the official Genymobile releases and creates a shortcut with
> your settings and a recolored icon: a Linux `.desktop` file, or a Windows
> `.lnk` in the Start Menu (command baked directly into the shortcut).

- Page: https://zonaro.github.io/scrcpy-installer/
- Repo: https://github.com/zonaro/scrcpy-installer
- Installer (Linux): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zonaro/scrcpy-installer/main/install.sh
- Installer (Windows): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zonaro/scrcpy-installer/main/install.ps1
- Languages: pt-BR (default), en, es — persisted in localStorage, auto-detected
- Privacy: the form runs 100% client-side (vanilla JS, no analytics).
  CDN: zonaro/NameToColor (plain script) + Tango ya-webadb ESM
  (@yume-chan/adb@2.6.4, adb-daemon-webusb@2.3.2, adb-credential-web@2.1.0
  via jsdelivr `+esm`, inside `<script type="module">` only).
  State is serialized only into the URL #hash locally. WebADB traffic is
  local USB only (RSA key in browser IndexedDB `Tango`); no data leaves
  the browser.
- OS toggle: the form has a Linux/Windows selector (`os`, also `?os=windows`
  deep link). It switches the oneliner, the shortcut preview and the downloads.

## What the oneliner does (Linux)

`curl -fsSL <installer> | bash -s -- --shortcut-name 'Name'
--scrcpy-args '<scrcpy flags>' [--version <tag>] [--icon-bg/fg/screen/eyes <#hex>]`

1. Downloads the official prebuilt scrcpy (x86_64 glibc) or falls back to the
   distro package manager (other archs / musl).
2. Verifies SHA256 against the official SHA256SUMS.txt.
3. Installs to ~/.local (or /usr/local as root) and ensures PATH.
4. Downloads the official scrcpy.svg icon, recolors it
   (bg #077063, body/antennas #30dd81, screen #e4e4e4, eyes #ffffff by default).
5. Writes ~/.local/share/applications/<slug>.desktop with Exec=scrcpy <flags>.

Alternative output: download the `.desktop` file directly (for users who
already have scrcpy installed) and save it to ~/.local/share/applications/.

## What the one-liner does (Windows)

Canonical form emitted by the page:

`& ([scriptblock]::Create((Invoke-RestMethod 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zonaro/scrcpy-installer/main/install.ps1'))) -ShortcutName 'Name' -ScrcpyArgs '<scrcpy flags>' [-Version <tag>] [-IconBg/-IconFg/-IconScreen/-IconEyes <#hex>]`

1. Downloads the official prebuilt `scrcpy-win64-<version>.zip`
   (64-bit OS), `scrcpy-winarm64-<version>.zip` (ARM64 OS, v5.0+), or
   `scrcpy-win32-<version>.zip` (32-bit OS) — all arches have
   official prebuilts, so there is no package-manager fallback. For versions
   older than v5.0 on ARM64, the win64 build runs under x64 emulation.
2. Verifies SHA256 against the official SHA256SUMS.txt.
3. Extracts to %LOCALAPPDATA%\scrcpy\lib\scrcpy\<version>
   (or %ProgramFiles%\scrcpy with -System, needs elevation) and registers that
   folder on PATH (User, or Machine with -System), pruning older versions.
4. Downloads the official scrcpy.svg icon, recolors it with the same 4 colors
   as Linux, saves <slug>.svg, and generates <slug>.ico (GDI+, no external
   converter) with the same colors for the shortcut.
5. Writes the shortcut in the Start Menu (`scrcpy-installer` folder):
   `<slug>.lnk` (TargetPath=scrcpy.exe, Arguments=baked-in flags,
   custom .ico, working dir = install dir). No intermediate .bat launcher.

Parameter mapping (same semantics, PowerShell naming): --version → -Version,
--prefix → -Prefix, --system → -System, --force → -Force, --no-deps → -NoDeps
(no-op on Windows, the prebuilt is self-contained), --no-checksum →
-NoChecksum, --uninstall → -Uninstall, --shortcut-name → -ShortcutName,
--scrcpy-args → -ScrcpyArgs, --icon-bg/fg/screen/eyes → -IconBg/-IconFg/
-IconScreen/-IconEyes, --icon-url → -IconUrl, --shortcut-only → -ShortcutOnly.

Alternative outputs: the full setup as `scrcpy-setup.ps1`, and a standalone
shortcut-creator `<slug>-atalho.ps1` (creates the same .lnk via WScript.Shell,
for users who already have scrcpy installed).

## Supported scrcpy options (v3.3.4 + v4 delta + v5 delta)

Connection: --serial, --select-usb/-d, --select-tcpip/-e, --tcpip, --port/-p.
Video: --max-size/-m, --video-bit-rate/-b, --max-fps, --video-codec
(h264|h265|av1), --video-encoder, --video-source (display|camera),
--display-id, --capture-orientation, --crop, --no-video,
--hwdec (auto|disabled|vaapi on Linux|d3d11va on Windows).
Window: --fullscreen/-f, --no-window, --always-on-top, --window-borderless,
--window-title, --window-width/--window-height, --disable-screensaver, --print-fps.
Audio: --no-audio, --audio-codec (opus|aac|flac|raw), --audio-bit-rate,
--audio-source (output|playback|mic|mic-unprocessed|mic-camcorder|
mic-voice-recognition|mic-voice-communication|voice-call|voice-call-uplink|
voice-call-downlink|voice-performance), --audio-dup, --audio-buffer.
Input: --no-control/-n, --keyboard, --mouse, --gamepad (+ -K/-M/-G shorthands),
--prefer-text, --raw-key-events, --no-key-repeat, --legacy-paste,
--no-clipboard-autosync, --shortcut-mod, --push-target.
Recording/camera/virtual display: --record/-r, --record-format,
--camera-facing/size/fps, --new-display, --start-app.
Device: --otg, --stay-awake/-w, --turn-screen-off/-S, --show-touches/-t,
--power-off-on-close, --time-limit.
v4-only: --flex-display/-x, --render-fit, --keep-active, --background-color,
--camera-torch.
v5-only: --hwdec.

Validation rules enforced with warnings: --prefer-text XOR --raw-key-events
(sdk keyboard only); --mouse=sdk needs video playback; --audio-dup needs
--audio-source=playback; camera options auto-enable --video-source=camera.

## About scrcpy (summary of scrcpy.dev)

Free, open-source Android screen mirroring and control (Apache 2.0,
Genymobile). No root, no account, no ads, works offline over USB or TCP/IP.
30–120 fps, 35–70 ms latency, 1080p+, ~1 s startup. Audio needs Android 11+,
camera needs Android 12+. Minimum device: Android 5.0 (API 21) with USB
debugging enabled.

## Legal (summary)

Unofficial page, no affiliation with Genymobile. Informational content only,
no warranties, use at your own risk. No data collection on this page.
scrcpy is Apache 2.0; the installer script is MIT.

## Query-string API (deep links / AI-generated links)

Every scrcpy long flag works as a query param WITHOUT the leading `--`.
Booleans are bare: `?no-audio&fullscreen&stay-awake`.
Valued flags use `=`: `?max-size=1024&video-codec=h265&window-title=TV`.
Extra params (not scrcpy flags):
`shortcut-name`, `version` (latest|v5.0|v4.1|v3.3.4|any other tag),
`K|M|G` (bare = physical keyboard/mouse/gamepad),
`icon-bg|icon-fg|icon-screen|icon-eyes` (hex, same defaults as installer),
`os` (linux|windows — selects the installer variant in the page; auto-detected
from the browser when absent, explicit `?os=` / manual toggle wins and is
remembered in localStorage `scrcpy-gen-os`).
Full example:
`?shortcut-name=TV&version=v5.0&max-size=1024&no-audio&video-codec=h265&fullscreen&icon-bg=%23000000`
Precedence on load: `#hash` state first, then query string (query wins),
then live edits. The "Copy link of this config" button serializes the
current form back into this exact format (canonical page URL + `?` + params).

## .desktop upload (reverse edit)

The file input accepts an existing `.desktop` file. The parser reads:
- `Name=` -> config name field (surrounding quotes stripped).
- `Exec=` -> shell-like tokenization (single/double quotes respected),
  first token (binary path) dropped, then long flags as `--flag=value` or
  `--flag value`, plus short flags `-d -e -f -n -K -M -G -w -S -t -x`
  (booleans) and `-s -p -m -b -r` (with value). `--keyboard=uhid` maps to the
  keyboard select (not the -K checkbox); `-K` maps to the checkbox.
  Unknown/unsupported flags are listed in the `#uploadNote` line, nothing
  is silently dropped. Icon colors are NOT recovered (SVG has no metadata
  about the recolor); they stay at the form's current values.

## Icon pipeline (official SVG, recolored)

The preview embeds the byte-identical official
`Genymobile/scrcpy @ master : app/data/scrcpy.svg`, except the recolorable
shapes use presentation attributes + ids instead of `style="fill:..."`:
`#pvBg` (Tela/frame, default #077063), `#pvFg` + `#pvAnt1/#pvAnt2` (Corpo
Android/body+antennas, default #30dd81), `#pvScreen` (Monitor/lower screen,
default #e4e4e4), `#pvEye1/#pvEye2` (Olhos Android/eyes, default #ffffff).
`#pvBase` (stand base, ex-#cccccc) has no input: `update()` sets
`pvBase.style.fill = pvBase.fill = Monitor` so it always follows the Monitor
with the exact same color. Other shadows/highlights (opacity layers)
are untouched. Live preview sets fill/stroke attributes.
`install.sh` does the equivalent server-side with case-insensitive
`sed s/#077063/<bg>/gI` etc. on the downloaded SVG, so preview and installed
icon always match (except the auto-derived base, preview-only).

Icon editor (NameToColor.js): `docs/index.html` loads
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/zonaro/NameToColor@main/NameToColor.js` +
`NameToColor.ptBR.js` via plain `<script>` (offline = picker-only fallback
with `#ntcWarn`). Layout in `#s-icon`: mood row FIRST (grouped `#iconMood`
select with the 69 canonical themes, free-text `#iconMoodName`, apply +
shuffle buttons), then the 4 color fields (order: Tela, Corpo Android, Olhos
Android, Monitor). Each slot keeps its `<input type=color>` (source of truth,
hex) plus a free-text input (`iconBgName/iconFgName/iconEyesName/
iconScreenName`) resolved with `generateColor()` + `normalizeHex()`; hints
show `hex · colorName()` in the page locale (pt-BR via the pack, en natively,
es falls back to en). Mood palette calls `generateThemePalette(resolveTheme
(mood), 4)` and maps `[Tela, Corpo Android, Monitor, Olhos Android]` at once;
`resolveTheme()` matches canonical names plus every `themeAliases` pt alias
from the pack (accent-insensitive, e.g. "por do sol" -> Sunset). Select
option text uses the pack too (`moodNames` first, then first `themeAliases`
entry capitalized) when LANG=pt; option values stay canonical English.
i18n: every new string has pt (inline `orig`) + en + es entries
(`f_icon*`, `b_mood`, `ph_mood`, `ph_colorbg/fg/eyes/screen`, `t_shuffle`
via `data-i18n-title`, `a_mood`, `ntc_offline`, `g_moods/nature/materials/
audience/occasions/styles/industry`); `applyLang()` handles `data-i18n`,
`data-i18n-ph` and `data-i18n-title`, and `buildMoodSelect()` re-localizes
optgroups/options/aria-label on language change. Query params stay
hex (`icon-bg|icon-fg|icon-screen|icon-eyes`) and also accept arbitrary names
via `setIconColor()`.

## Form widgets (toggles, presets, autocomplete)

- Booleans render as toggle switches: `.checkrow input[type=checkbox]`
  styled with `appearance:none` (44x24 pill, sliding knob). Same DOM/ids,
  so `checked(id)`, QMAP type `b`, `restore()` and `buildArgs()` are untouched.
- Preset+free-text fields use `input + datalist` (select-like dropdown that
  still accepts custom values, keeping `val(id)`/`setField(..., "t")` intact):
  `#maxSize` (#maxSizeList: 640/720/1024/1280/1920/2560),
  `#bitrate` (#bitrateList: 2M/4M/8M/12M/16M/25M),
  `#abitrate` (#abitrateList: 32K/64K/128K/192K/256K),
  `#encoder` (#encoderList: OMX.google/c2 encoders),
  `#port` (#portList: 27183, 27183:27199),
  `#shortcutMod` (#shortcutModList), `#pushTarget` (#pushTargetList:
  /sdcard/Download/, Movies/, DCIM/), `#camSize` (#camSizeList),
  `#newDisplay` (#newDisplayList), `#bgColor` (#bgColorList).
  Strict enums stay real `<select>` (codec, video-source, audio-source,
  keyboard/mouse/gamepad, record-format, camera-facing, render-fit,
  capture-orientation).

## WebADB device panel (USB only, Chromium desktop + HTTPS)

- Section `#s-adb`: buttons `#adbConnect` (requestDevice), `#adbRefresh`
  (granted devices), status `#adbStatus`,
  list `#adbList`. Non-Chromium/no-WebUSB disables the buttons with
  `adb_no_usb`. Classic-script helpers on `window` (`__adbStore`,
  `__adbSetStatus/__adbRenderList/__adbUpdateDatalists`, `window.ScrGen.t`
  bridge for i18n) so the ESM module manipulates the same state.
- Connect flow (module script): `AdbDaemonWebUsbDeviceManager.BROWSER` +
  `AdbWebCredentialStore("ScrcpyInstaller")` -> `requestDevice()` (user
  gesture, `undefined` = cancel) -> `device.connect()` ->
  `AdbDaemonTransport.authenticate()` (blocks until the phone taps Allow)
  -> `new Adb(transport)`. Info via `subprocess.noneProtocol.spawnWaitText`:
  model `getprop ro.product.model`, IPs `ip -f inet addr show scope global`
  (fallback `ip -4 -o addr show scope global`, parses `inet X`, drops 127.*),
  apps `cmd package query-activities --brief -a MAIN -c LAUNCHER`
  (fallback `pm list packages -3`, then full `pm list packages`).
- Serial/IP autocomplete: `#serialList`/`#tcpipList` datalists rebuilt from
  `__adbStore.devices` (serial + `ip`/`ip:5555` with model labels); device
  cards have `usar` button filling `#serial`.
- No Wi-Fi activate/reconnect from the page (no raw TCP
  in browsers; Tango needs a native bridge).
- `--start-app` autocomplete: `#startApp` + `#appSuggest` custom dropdown
  (classic script, no imports). Merged+deduped `__adbStore.pkgs`
  (`{pkg, device}`), substring match, launchable-first ordering, max 30,
  mouse+ArrowUp/Down+Enter+Escape, preserves scrcpy `+`/`?` prefixes on pick.
  i18n keys: `s_adb/h_adb/b_adbadd/b_adbrefresh/
  h_adbpriv/h_startapp/adb_no_usb/adb_cancel/adb_need_gesture/
  adb_authorize/adb_busy/adb_lost/adb_connected/
  adb_use/adb_apps/adb_no_apps/adb_no_dev` (pt inline + en + es).

## Page internals (for automation)

- Single file `docs/index.html`, vanilla JS, CDN: zonaro/NameToColor
  (`NameToColor.js` + `NameToColor.ptBR.js` via jsdelivr, plain script tags).
- i18n: `data-i18n` keys, `I18N = {en:{...}, es:{...}}`, pt-BR inline as
  fallback (`el.dataset.orig`), persisted `localStorage scrcpy-gen-lang`.
- State: `QMAP` = [[query-flag, fieldId, type]] with types
  t(ext)|s(elect)|b(bool)|tv (tcpip flag+value); `buildArgs()` emits flags
  in stable order with shell quoting; `buildQuery()` inverts it for links.
- Outputs: `#oneliner` (install+shortcut), `#desktopPrev` (.desktop text on
  Linux, .lnk Target/Arguments preview on Windows), shortcut download named
  `<slug>.desktop` / `<slug>-atalho.ps1`, installer download wrapping the
  oneliner as `scrcpy-setup.sh` / `scrcpy-setup.ps1`.
- Windows branch: `isWin()` reads `#os`; `psSingle()` PowerShell-quotes args;
  `selVersion()` is shared by both branches; `#dlHint/#deskSum/#dlShortcutBtn/
  #dlBtn/#deskDir/#deskExt` are re-rendered per OS in `update()`.
